shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' | head -100 && printf '\\n--- root ---\\n' && ls -la"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files src __agent_eval__ -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' && printf '\\n--- src contents ---\\n' && for f in "'$(rg --files src); do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html && printf '\\n--- eval ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc "rg \"@gravity-ui/i18n|i18next|ThemeProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' -m 1 | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && printf '\\n--- exports ---\\n' && rg \"const I18N|function register|registerKeysets\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/index.d.ts && printf '\\n--- theme i18n docs ---\\n' && rg -n \"export function|setLang|registerKeysets\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/build/esm/I18n.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const m=require('@gravity-ui/uikit'); console.log(Object.keys(m).filter(k=>/Segment|Select|Button|Tabs|Lang/i.test(k)).join('\\n'))\" && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useLang.d.ts && printf '\\n--- Segment type ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedControls/SegmentedControls.d.ts 2>/dev/null || cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/SegmentedControls/SegmentedControls.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -g '*Segment*' -g '*.d.ts' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | rg "Segment|Tabs|Select|Button|LanguageIcon|Globe" | head -50'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || true; find / -name apply_patch -type f 2>/dev/null | head'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- i18n ---\\n' && ls -l src/i18n.ts 2>/dev/null || true && cat src/i18n.ts 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg "SegmentedRadioGroup|option|control" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/*.css | head -30'
/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "SegmentedRadioGroup" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head'

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/  const contextValue = useMemo\\(\\(\\) => \\(\\{ language, setLanguage \\}\\), \\[language\\]\\);/  appI18n.setLang(language);\\n\\n  const contextValue = useMemo(() => ({ language, setLanguage }), [language]);/\" src/i18n.tsx
perl -0pi -e \"s/  useEffect\\(\\(\\) => \\{\\n    appI18n.setLang\\(language\\);/  useEffect(() => {\\n/\" src/i18n.tsx
npm run build
printf '\\n--- i18n.tsx ---\\n'
cat src/i18n.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/  useEffect\\(\\(\\) => \\{\\n\\n/  useEffect(() => {\\n/\" src/i18n.tsx
cat .gitignore
git status --short
git diff --check
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- i18n ---\\n' && nl -ba src/i18n.tsx && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && nl -ba src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && nl -ba src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/  useEffect\\(\\(\\) => \\{\\n    document\\.documentElement\\.lang = language;\\n  \\}, \\[language\\]\\);\\n\\n  appI18n\\.setLang\\(language\\);\\n\\n  const contextValue = useMemo\\(\\(\\) => \\(\\{ language, setLanguage \\}\\), \\[language\\]\\);/  useEffect(() => {\\n    document.documentElement.lang = language;\\n  }, [language]);\\n\\n  const contextValue = useMemo(() => {\\n    appI18n.setLang(language);\\n    return { language, setLanguage };\\n  }, [language]);/\" src/i18n.tsx
node -e \"import('node:fs').then(({ rmSync }) => rmSync('dist', { recursive: true }))\"
npm run build
node -e \"import('node:fs').then(({ rmSync }) => rmSync('dist', { recursive: true }))\"
git diff --check
git status --short
printf '\\n--- i18n final ---\\n'
sed -n '35,60p' src/i18n.tsx"
